title: lobelia quadrisepala
intro: Lobelia quadrisepala, commonly known as the "Alaska Larkspur" or "Fragrant Lobelia", is a species of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. It is used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia quadrisepala include its ability to relax muscles, reduce respiratory congestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, such as lobeline, lobelanine, and choline, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
